summary_md: **Qikaman ([@qikamatata](https://x.com/qikamatata/status/2116021959507231189))** highlights **earshot**, a CPU-only MCP-capable tool letting coding agents hear and review sound, noting its author misjudged 7 of 15 blind tests on synthetic audio and that it only reaches 14 kHz, so it's for screening rather than final calls ([Leonxlnx/earshot](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot)).
